brief:
CBS News foreign editor Shayndi Raice detailed her reasoning for excluding Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from an October 7 commemorative script, according to Zeteo. The decision prompted discussion about editorial choices in covering Israel-related content.

Raice also addressed the Palestinian death toll in Gaza during the exchange, though the specific details of her comments were not elaborated in the summary provided.
dek: CBS News foreign editor Shayndi Raice explained exactly why Netanyahu was removed from an Oct. 7 script. You also won’t believe what she said about the Palestinian death toll in Gaza.
title: CBS foreign editor explains Netanyahu removal from October 7 script
